**UI Audit: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (Windows)**

### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized, excluding Windows taskbar).
*   **Title Bar:** [0,0] to [1024,45]. Contains App Icon, Title, "Buy Now" CTA, and Window Controls.
*   **Toolbar Cluster:** [0,46] to [1024,115]. 
    *   Nav Group (Home, Back, Forward, Up): [10,65] to [145,105].
    *   Address/Breadcrumb Bar: [165,65] to [660,105].
    *   View/Filter/Search Group: [670,65] to [990,105].
*   **Main Content Area:** [0,120] to [1024,850]. Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Tree Pane (Left):** [0,120] to [275,850]. Contains Path/Type tabs and directory tree.
    *   **File List Pane (Center):** [275,120] to [795,850]. Contains column headers, list rows, and vertical scrollbar.
    *   **Preview/Details Pane (Right):** [795,120] to [1024,850]. Shows file preview icon, name, size, and action button.
*   **Status Bar (Bottom):** [0,851] to [1024,950]. Contains scan status summary and primary "Recover" CTA.
*   **Overlay/Toast:** "AI Recommend available" popup centered over the right pane [715,490] to [988,630].

### 2. TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Toolbar:** `Buy Now`, `Filter`, `Search files or folders`
*   **Address Bar:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Tabs:** `Path`, `Type`
*   **Tree Pane Headers/Items:** `Name` (implicit), `Windows (C:)`, `File Path Lost`, `Reconstructed`. Counts: `1.11M`, `4.4K`, `95`.
*   **List Headers:** `Name`, `Date Modified`, `Type`.
*   **List Items (Sample):**
    *   `actionarchivecache` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `actions-runner` | `10/17/2026 6:38 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `azureCli` | `10/8/2026 1:50 AM` | `File folder`
    *   `cobertura-2.1.1` | `2/26/2015 11:23 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `ghcup` | `10/8/2026 12:32 AM` | `File folder`
    *   `hostedtoolcache` | `10/7/2026 11:25 P...` | `File folder`
    *   `image` | `10/7/2026 9:08 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `inetpub` | `10/7/2026 10:10 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `Julia` | `10/7/2026 11:21 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `mingw32` | `2/19/2026 12:59 PM` | `File folder`
*   **Preview Pane:** `actionarchivecache`, `Open`, `Size`, `284 MB`.
*   **Status Bar:** `Scan Completed, Files Found:` **`1139229`** `(147.10 GB)`, `Recover All ...`
*   **Popup:** `AI Recommend available.`, `View Details`.
*   **System Tray (OS):** `6:58 PM`, `10/17/2026`.

### 3. COLOR (Estimated Hex)
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/App BG: `#F5F7FA` (Light Blue-Grey)
    *   Content Panes (List/Tree): `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Selected Row: `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue)
    *   Title Bar: `#FFFFFF`
*   **Accents & CTAs:**
    *   Primary Button (Buy Now, Recover): `#2D7FF9` (Bright Blue)
    *   Primary Button Text: `#FFFFFF`
    *   Secondary Button (Open): `#D6E4FF` (Pale Blue) with `#2D7FF9` text.
    *   Popup Background: `#1877F2` (Facebook-style Blue)
    *   Link/Accent Text: `#2D7FF9`
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text: `#333333` (Dark Grey)
    *   Secondary/Meta Text: `#888888` (Grey)
    *   Disabled/Inactive Tab Text: `#666666`
*   **Borders/Separators:**
    *   Pane Dividers: `#E0E0E0`
    *   Input Borders: `#CCCCCC`
    *   Grid Lines (Row bottom): `#F0F0F0`

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Font Family:** Segoe UI (Standard Windows System Font).
*   **Title Bar / Header:** 12px - Regular.
*   **Tree/List Items:** 13px - Regular.
*   **Status Bar Summary:** 14px - Bold (for the count), Regular for label.
*   **Button Text:** 13px - Medium/SemiBold.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Row Height (List):** ~42px per row.
*   **Icon Size (List/Tree):** 24x24px (Folder icons).
*   **Checkbox Size:** 16x16px (standard Windows checkbox).
*   **Padding:**
    *   List Item Left Padding: ~40px (to accommodate checkbox + icon).
    *   Pane Gutter: ~5px (divider width).
    *   Button Padding (Horizontal): 16px, (Vertical): 8px.
*   **Radii:**
    *   Buttons: 4px - 6px.
    *   Search Box / Inputs: 4px.
    *   Popup Toast: 8px.
*   **Shadows:**
    *   Popup Toast: Drop shadow `0px 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)`.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Navigation Buttons:** Home, Back (Disabled/Greyed), Forward (Disabled/Greyed), Up (Disabled/Greyed). State: Normal/Disabled.
*   **Address Bar:** Read-only display of current path. State: Static.
*   **View Toggle:** Hamburger/List icon. State: Normal.
*   **Filter Button:** Text + Funnel Icon. State: Normal.
*   **Search Box:** Placeholder text "Search files or folders". State: Empty/Normal.
*   **Tabs:** "Path" (Selected/Active - White bg, top border), "Type" (Inactive - Grey bg).
*   **Tree View:** Expandable nodes. "Windows (C:)" is Expanded. Checkboxes present but unchecked.
*   **List View:**
    *   **Header:** Sortable columns. "Name" has Up Arrow indicator.
    *   **Rows:** Checkbox (Unchecked), Folder Icon, Name, Date, Type.
    *   **Selection:** First row ("actionarchivecache") is Selected (Blue background highlight).
*   **Preview Pane:**
    *   Large Folder Icon.
    *   "Open" Button (Secondary style).
    *   Metadata Label/Value pair.
*   **Status Bar:**
    *   Success Icon (Checkmark in circle).
    *   Text Status.
    *   "Recover All ..." Button (Primary style, solid blue).
*   **Popup/Toast:**
    *   Close 'X' button (top right).
    *   "View Details" button (White background, blue text).

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline/Filled hybrid (Fluent Design influence).
*   **Nav Icons:** Outline (Home, Arrows).
*   **File Icons:** Filled (Yellow/Blue folders).
*   **Action Icons:** Outline (Filter funnel, Search magnifying glass, Sort arrow, View grid).
*   **Weights:** 1.5px - 2px stroke for outlines.

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Populated**.
*   **Context:** A scan has completed successfully (`Scan Completed`). The file system tree is populated with results (`Files Found: 1139229`). The user has selected a specific folder (`actionarchivecache`) which is displayed in the preview pane.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot), but the "AI Recommend" toast implies a recent or triggered event. The scroll bar in the list view indicates the list extends beyond the viewport.
